items.name: 유령들이 밝힌 호박 정원
items.referenceRole: Painterly underwater style and open central space; distinct Halloween architecture and props
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production background for a portrait mobile AQUARIUM game, vertical 9:16 composition. Reference is STYLE and OPEN CENTRAL PLAY SPACE only: painterly polished fantasy underwater illustration with warm lamps and deep aquatic blue depth; do not copy Japanese architecture or tea props. Create 'The Ghosts' Pumpkin Garden', a beautiful cute-spooky HALLOWEEN garden entirely SUBMERGED UNDERWATER. Upper left/right borders: sunken wrought iron gothic garden arch fragments covered in teal kelp, purple coral and tiny softly glowing pumpkin lanterns hung by chains. Lower side terraces: three or four carved amber jack-o-lanterns with cozy light, violet anemones, small old stone garden gate and broken mossy steps. Two tiny friendly translucent sheet ghosts at far side edges only, not center. A very distant softened haunted conservatory on the FAR RIGHT background. Subtle bubbles, top rippling water caustics and soft lavender-blue underwater shafts; unmistakably underwater, no land sky, open air moon, dry forest or human room. Main central 60% width from top to lower quarter is calm unobstructed low contrast deep turquoise-indigo water fading into distance for live fish overlay. Keep high contrast decoration at perimeter and lower corners. Bottommost 15% a gently lit clean sandy seabed, no big foreground centerpiece. Elegant rich warm amber vs cool violet-teal palette, detailed built structures of a special premium theme, magical and cozy instead of frightening. High-quality cohesive full-bleed painting, no fish or large characters baked in, no text, letters, UI, watermark, border or logos. Opaque complete background.

deployment.scope: single aquarium background row and public image hash
